answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a nadir bet on surviving 69 epochs of grading, and every vertex settlement recomputes the wharf schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 69 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
